entity.name: AITWIRE
entity.description: AITWIRE is an AI Answer Measurement & Assurance platform. It tests public AI platforms and private enterprise AI systems against defined facts, sources, policies and expectations — providing evidence of answer accuracy, grounding, quality, consistency and control conformance. Testing is controlled and repeatable: the same questions are asked cold across the 9 probed AI answer engines and re-asked after a change, reported with sample sizes and 95% confidence intervals, so findings are traceable and movement is reported only when it clears the statistics. AITWIRE publishes verified information across canonical web pages, structured data, feeds and machine-readable interfaces — then measures which systems retrieve, reflect or cite it; adoption of any given machine-readable surface varies by AI platform and cannot be guaranteed. AITWIRE verifies — it does not write your prose. Category: AI Answer Measurement & Assurance.

entity.narrative:
# About AITWIRE

AITWIRE verifies how AI systems answer questions about your business. It is an AI Answer Assurance platform: it measures what the 9 AI engines powering 90%+ of AI answers — ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, Grok, and others — say about a business, calibrates the record with the verified facts you approve, and proves what changes over time. Calibration is a layer the customer chooses: AITWIRE publishes your confirmed facts to the authority surfaces it manages and re-measures whether the answers improved, proving any improvement only when it clears the statistics — with before-and-after evidence.

## Measure → Calibrate → Prove

1. **Measure** — AITWIRE asks the major AI answer engines controlled questions about your business — the same questions your customers ask — and scores every response across five quality dimensions (accuracy, citation, quality, sentiment, and recommendation), reported with sample sizes and 95% confidence intervals.
2. **Calibrate** — Measured gaps become prioritized recommendations backed by data briefs, plus verified machine-readable authority surfaces (entity.json, JSON-LD, llms.txt, structured feeds) published from facts you have confirmed. AITWIRE verifies and proves; it does not write your prose. Every AI-proposed correction is suggest-and-confirm — nothing goes live without your approval.
3. **Prove** — The same metrics are re-measured after each change, and movement is reported as real only when it clears the statistics. You get evidence you can defend, not vibes.

## What AITWIRE is not

AITWIRE is not an SEO tool and not a content generator. SEO optimizes search rankings; content tools write prose. AITWIRE is a verification layer: it measures how AI systems answer about your business, calibrates the record with the verified facts you approve, and proves what changes over time. When you choose to calibrate, it publishes your verified facts to the surfaces it manages and re-measures the result — with before-and-after evidence.

## Plans

- **AITWIRE Free** — your AI answer baseline: a recurring AI Update with a per-system breakdown and the specific misrepresentations AI makes about you, plus basic authority surfaces (entity.json, llms.txt, JSON-LD). No credit card required.
- **AITWIRE Standard ($99 CAD/mo)** — AI Monitoring: monthly AI Update cycle, drift and sentiment alerts, AI Signal review, edge-deployed authority surfaces, and a monthly AI Answer Benchmark Report.
- **AITWIRE Pro ($439 CAD/mo)** — Continuous AI Monitoring + calibration: weekly AI Updates, competitor tracking (up to 5 competitors), AI Insights and Search Presence monitoring, a prioritized queue of website content recommendations with data briefs, publishing to your own site, and measured proof of what changed.
- **AITWIRE Custom (contact for quote)** — the managed Assurance Loop run daily: unlimited competitors with Share of AI Voice and displacement attribution, commerce representation assurance, advanced governance, full REST API, and a dedicated account manager.

## About the company

AITWIRE is a bootstrapped Canadian SaaS company founded by Matt Herbert, built on Cloudflare Workers and a multi-model AI gateway. AITWIRE also operates a structured business authority directory of machine-readable entity profiles published via the AITWIRE Open Entity Data Protocol (entity.json, llms.txt, JSON-LD), which AI retrieval and training pipelines can read as a neutral, verified source of business entity information.
